conviction_note: Near-zero: since 2026-08-31 the stock has traded as a takeover candidate (House Foods, 51%, exploring a sale; Ichibanya says it is considering going private), which anchors the price at ~1,095 and damps any earnings reaction. The 月次 already show the quarter tracking the H1 plan, and the only negative (a possible full-year cut) is an inference from a public progress rate. So the findings net to +0.2, p_up is 51 and abs_move is 1.5, below the pre-deal 2.04 proxy.
bar: Company H1 plan, operating profit 2,160m yen (sales 35,840m, ordinary 2,130m, net 1,210m), unrevised since 2026-04-06 and reaffirmed in the Q1 短信: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260626/140120260626581301.pdf . IFIS consensus via kabuyoho is full-year ordinary profit 5,100m against the company's 5,040m, described as 会社予想並み (in line with the company plan), with no ratings: https://kabuyoho.jp/reportTop?bcode=7630 . There is no H1 consensus, so the bar is the company plan.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% (not on the register, so no disclosed position at or above 0.5%), change 0.0 pts, as of 2026-09-29 (baseline; https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 9.78 in the baseline and 10.58 on irbank (margin buy 520,600 against sell 49,200, as of 2026-09-14, https://irbank.net/7630), so leveraged retail is crowded long after the 2026-08-31 limit-up on the sale report. There is no option skew. The priced lean is -0.48, almost all of it margin overhang. The 20-day run-up is -0.36% and the 5-day run-up -0.99%.

findings.finding: Domestic CoCo existing-store sales ran +2.4% in Jun, +0.4% in Jul and +4.5% in Aug 2026, and H1 traffic is flat (100.0%) against 94.6% last year. That is the same top-line momentum as Q1 (+2.5% SSS), when operating profit was 1,085m (-14.3%), on plan to the decimal (H1 plan -14.5%). Q2 needs 1,075m against 1,260m last year, so H1 operating profit lands at or slightly above the 2,160m plan. Q1 ordinary profit (53.7% of plan) and net profit (60% of plan) progress point to a beat below the operating line unless there is a special loss like last year's Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last year H1 operating profit beat the 2,200m plan by 15% (2,526m) and the estimated-cadence reaction was +1.84% (baseline, 2025-10-06). This year Q1 progress is 50.2% of the H1 plan against 57.5% last year, so the beat should be smaller. The takeover anchor damps the reaction further.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the 月次 have been public since 2026-09-04. What is left is the gap between an in-line operating line and a likely beat at ordinary and net level, which the 月次 cannot show. Had the market priced a large beat, the stock would have drifted up into the print rather than sitting 1% below its 5-day level.
findings.independence: Q1 短信 (a different document) supplies the plan and the progress rate: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260626/140120260626581301.pdf . The price action rests on the 月次 alone.

findings.finding: Ichibanya confirmed on 2026-08-31 that it is 'considering various options including going private' after a Nikkei/Kyodo report that House Foods (51.00%) is looking to sell its stake, with several funds said to be bidding. The stock went limit-up to 1,091 and has held about 1,095 since, so it now trades on deal probability. That damps an earnings reaction and leaves a small right tail: a sale or going-private disclosure timed with results.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-08-31 report alone moved the stock +15.9% (limit-up, 941 to 1,091), per kabutan/Fisco: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7630&b=n202608310769
findings.why_not_priced: Most of it is priced: the deal premium is already in the 1,095 level. What remains is the small chance that the process is announced with results. Reports on 2026-08-31 had proposals being solicited 'soon', so a definitive announcement inside this window is unlikely, and no source dates one. Had the market priced an imminent deal, the stock would be bid above the limit-up level rather than flat for five weeks.
findings.independence: Kyodo via Kumamoto Nichinichi, 2026-08-31: https://kumanichi.com/articles/2030808 . The-shashi summary of House Foods' parallel disclosure, updated 2026-09-12: https://the-shashi.com/tse/2810/decisions/ichibanya-privatization-2026/

findings.finding: The full-year plan (operating profit 5,000m, +6%) needs H2 operating profit of about 2,840m against 2,189m last year (+30%). Last year the company held its full-year plan (5,400m) at the H1 print and then missed by 13% (4,715m). A cut at this print is possible but not the base case: on 2026-08-28 the company said the Sept 1 late-night surcharge (7%, 22:00-05:00) and the topping price rises (12 of 44 items, +17% average) do not change its forecast, and consensus sits above the plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no full-year revision at an H1 print in 2024-2026. The 2026-04-06 full-year print, with a mid-term plan cut, drew an estimated -3.55% (baseline, 2026-04-07).
findings.why_not_priced: The progress gap can be computed from public documents, so a hold is no news. Only a cut would add information, and the company's own record (held last year) argues against one. Kept small for that reason.
findings.independence: kabutan forecast history (no revision in FY2026 between the initial plan and the result): https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=7630

outside_window.finding: House Foods' sale of its 51% stake or an Ichibanya going-private transaction. Reports had funds bidding and proposals to be solicited, and no date is sourced. A tender offer would carry a premium over the current level.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: not expected; the company held its FY plan at last year's H1 and consensus (5,100m ordinary) is at or above the plan. Returns: interim 8 yen held per plan, and no buyback is likely while a sale process runs. New-year guide: n/a (H1). Quarter: Q1 operating profit progress 50.2% of the H1 plan against 57.5% last year; Q2 月次 SSS +2.4% average, in line, so H1 operating profit is about at plan, with ordinary and net likely above.

baseline_tension: Roughly agrees with the baseline: it has a flat run-up and a small negative lean from the crowded margin long, and I found no sizable unpriced item. The strongest positive the release could carry is a held FY forecast plus an H1 beat at ordinary and net level, plus any going-private news; I looked for all three, and only the first two are plausible inside the window.
lessons_applied: Rule 1: the guidance negative rests on a progress rate anyone can compute from the last 短信, so it moves from -0.3 to -0.2.

Rule 2: the strongest positive (held forecast, H1 beat below the operating line) is now written into baseline_tension. Looking at it again, the Q1 ordinary and net progress raised the reported-quarter finding from +0.1 to +0.2. p_up stays at 51 and abs_move at 1.5.
